FROM yh_smoking_comment AS a INNER JOIN `yh_user_reginfo` AS b ON a.`usercode`=b.`user_code` LEFT JOIN `yh_wx_user` AS c ON a.`usercode`=c.`user_id`
WHERE ( a.smoking_diary_id = #{lid} AND a.pid = 0 ) order by a.comment_time desc

FROM yh_smoking_comment AS a INNER JOIN `yh_user_reginfo` AS b ON a.`usercode`=b.`user_code` LEFT JOIN `yh_wx_user` AS c ON a.`usercode`=c.`user_id` LEFT JOIN yh_smoking_diarylike AS d ON a.comment_id=d.likediary_id WHERE ( a.smoking_diary_id = #{lid} AND a.pid = 0 )
and a.usercode=#{usercode}
order by a.comment_time desc limit #{page},10
